name: Mondelez/Nabisco Tatamy Sales Distribution Center - Tatamy PA

fieldNotes.location: Resolved to 120 Commerce Lane, Tatamy PA 18085 (Northampton County, Lehigh Valley) — a Becknell Industrial build-to-suit warehouse in the Tatamy/Palmer Township industrial park. Roster city-centroid (40.7401,-75.2557) was ~1km NE; corrected via web research (Becknell property page, Foursquare, Mondelez hourly-jobs portal all list 120 Commerce Lane) plus Nominatim geocode and satellite. The modern grey warehouse with purple accent striping and a fenced truck/drop yard matches the ~100,300 sq ft build-to-suit Nabisco DC.
fieldNotes.truckGate: TRUE — Street View (Jul 2024) of the Commerce Lane frontage shows chain-link perimeter fencing enclosing the truck/drop yard with branded trailers parked inside; the yard is accessed through a fenced gate off the loop road. A controlled, fenced industrial entrance.
fieldNotes.guardShack: FALSE — no staffed guard-booth structure visible at the yard entrance or building in Street View or satellite.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: TRUE — fenced/controlled truck gate present but no guard shack, implying kiosk / app / dock-office check-in.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 10-25 — dock doors line the south building face; ~20-24 estimated with many trailers backed in. Banded 10-25.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 25-50 — a long row of drop trailers parked in the yard alongside the docked trailers; counts in the 30-40 range.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: FALSE — all dock doors are on a single (south) building face.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: TRUE — wide paved truck yard with substantial unused apron width.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep truck yard / loop road can hold a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town build-to-suit industrial park bordered by other warehouses and single-family residential; judged Rural per the small-town-industrial tie-break.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: One warehouse on the Mondelez parcel; neighboring buildings in the Becknell park are separate tenants.
